config.about: Adult Drosophila optic lobe single-cell atlas (Adult_noglia.h5ad, glia removed). Cell type = MultiomeAnnotated; metacluster, temporal/spatial origin and Notch status come from the PNAS supplementary table, matched by cluster. UMAP computed here from the stored 200-d PCA (first 50 PCs); tSNE is the stored one.
